items.exampleEn: The manager will deal with your problem today.
items.exampleZh: 經理今天會處理你的問題。

items.exampleEn: The price depends on the size of the room.
items.exampleZh: 價格取決於房間的大小。

items.exampleEn: Drop by my office if you have time this afternoon.
items.exampleZh: 你今天下午有空的話，順道來我辦公室坐坐。

items.exampleEn: The taxi dropped us off in front of the hotel.
items.exampleZh: 計程車讓我們在飯店門口下車。

items.exampleEn: Please fill the form out and sign your name at the bottom.
items.exampleZh: 請填寫這張表格，並在最下面簽名。

items.exampleEn: The new shop gave away free bags on its first day.
items.exampleZh: 那家新店開幕第一天送出免費的袋子。

items.exampleEn: He went through a difficult time after he lost his job.
items.exampleZh: 他失業後經歷了一段艱難的時期。

items.sentenceEn: Could you drop off the kids at school on your way to work?
items.sentenceZh: 你上班途中可以順便送孩子們到學校嗎？

items.audioEn: Don't worry about the broken printer. I'll deal with it after lunch.
items.audioZh: 別擔心那台壞掉的印表機，我午餐後會處理。
items.questionZh: 說話的人午餐後要做什麼？
options: Print some papers for the meeting
Buy a new printer for the office
Take care of the printer problem

items.sentenceEn: Whether we go to the beach depends on the weather tomorrow.
items.sentenceZh: 我們要不要去海邊，要看明天的天氣。

items.sentenceEn: My aunt dropped by with a cake this afternoon.
items.sentenceZh: 我阿姨今天下午帶著蛋糕順道來訪。

items.stemEn: Our teacher knows how to ____ difficult students.
items.stemZh: 我們老師知道怎麼應付難搞的學生。

items.stemEn: A classmate ____ my house last night to return my notes.
items.stemZh: 一個同學昨晚順道到我家來還我的筆記。

items.passageEn: Last month, the Chen family moved to a smaller apartment in Taichung. Before the move, they went through every room and decided what to keep. They gave their old books away to their neighbors. Moving was tiring, and there were many small problems to deal with. At the new place, Mrs. Chen had to fill out several forms for water and electricity. Now the family is happy in their new home, and friends often drop by.
items.passageZh: 上個月，陳家搬到台中一間比較小的公寓。搬家前，他們把每個房間都仔細檢查過，決定要留下哪些東西。他們把舊書送給了鄰居。搬家很累，還有很多小問題要處理。到了新家，陳太太得填好幾張水電的表格。現在全家人在新家過得很開心，朋友也常常順道來看他們。

questions.questionZh: 陳太太在新家得做什麼？

items.promptZh: 我們全家在新的國家經歷了很多改變。
referenceEn: Our family went through many changes in the new country.
My family has gone through a lot of changes in the new country.
rubricZh: 建議用片語，例如 went through 等；不用片語但意思正確（例如 experienced、had many changes 等）也算對
時態可用過去式或現在完成式（例如 went through、has gone through、experienced 等）
「全家」可寫，例如 our family、my family 等
「很多改變」可寫，例如 many changes、a lot of changes 等

items.promptZh: 你可以在下一個路口讓我下車嗎？
referenceEn: Can you drop me off at the next corner?
Could you drop me off at the next corner?
rubricZh: 建議用片語，例如 drop me off 等（代名詞放中間）；不用片語但意思正確（例如 let me out、let me get off 等）也算對
請求可寫，例如 Can you、Could you、Would you 等
「下一個路口」可寫，例如 at the next corner 等
